final_payload.rationale_summary: Mexico's imports growth from 1995-12-31 to 1996-12-31 was 25.9472%, while the mean growth for United Kingdom and India was 6.5583%. The difference is 19.3889 percentage points, with Mexico higher. This was verified with evidence.
